context_for_next_testing_agent: Clara Global Protect is a 6-layer file scanning service that intercepts ALL uploads BEFORE S3 storage. Layers: 1) Extension validation (whitelist/blacklist), 2) MIME detection (python-magic), 3) MIME mismatch detection (anti-spoofing), 4) Malware signatures (PE/ELF/Mach-O headers), 5) Content patterns (XSS/eval/script tags), 6) Double extension attacks. Two blocking mechanisms: endpoint validation returns 400 for obvious bad file types, Global Protect returns 403 with 'Blocked by Clara Global Protect' message for detected threats. CLI commands: /protect status|logs|blocked|rules|threats. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_global_protect.py
